title: Finland Sees Continued Demand for Icebreakers Despite Warming Winters, Citing Security Concerns
content: Finland expects to operate at least as many icebreakers in the coming decades as it does today, despite rising temperatures and declining average ice coverage in the Baltic Sea. This is the conclusion of a new government-commissioned report that also highlights growing security requirements and changes in the commercial shipping fleet.

title: Iran Oil Exports Near Zero But Peace Deal Not Likely, FGE Says
content: Iranian oil exports have dwindled to almost nothing under the US naval blockade, but the chance of an imminent deal between the two sides to end the war is low, according to FGE NexantECA.
